name: Dither Serif
tagline: Bayer-dithered 3D forms, big serif headlines with one cobalt script word, floating UI and a skewed stamp that slams.
description: Crisp, playful launch style. Black-and-white 3D forms are shaded per pixel with an ordered Bayer threshold and shown as chunky pixels across clean white, vivid cobalt and black scenes. Headlines are a large elegant serif with ONE word swapped to a cobalt handwritten script, white UI cards float on blue, a big skewed cobalt stamp slams across the frame, and cuts use an iris or a halftone dot wipe. The preview follows a dithered mascot through a booking tool's storefront and checkout, ending on a white card with wordmark, tagline, cobalt button and URL.

display.usage: Headlines 104–170px, wordmark 230px, card titles and prices 50–70px, tracking -0.01em, never more than three lines

body.usage: UI text 17–38px: row titles, field text, buttons and pills

accent.usage: The ONE accent word per headline in cobalt (#0f4cff, or #5b86ff on black, white on cobalt), 1.35–2.1x the serif size, written on with a left-to-right clip reveal

transitions: iris: a clip-path circle opens from the main subject into the next colour scene (0.55s power2.in)
halftone wipe: a 30x17 dot grid grows to cover the frame then shrinks away in reverse order (0.62s), drawn on a canvas from the timeline
hard cut from white UI to black right after the stamp lands
textAnimations: serif lines slam up 80–110px with opacity 0 → 1, expo.out 0.5s, 0.12s stagger
script accent is revealed by clip-path inset left → right in 0.4s, then a cobalt squiggle underline draws on (pathLength 1 → 0)
stamp: scale 3.4 → 1 in 0.16s power3.in, then 1.04 bounce and a 4-step screen shake
numbers count while a slider knob or bar fill travels (e.g. $18 → $34)

rhythm.notes: Six beats: mascot intro + headline (1.4s), product cards (1.4s), phone storefront (1.5s), checkout UI with stamp (1.7s), black statement (1.2s), end card (1.25s). Something new lands every ~0.5s and nothing sits still longer than 1s.

guide:
- Look only: build the user's own subject in this visual language; don't reuse the example's scene.
- Palette: white #ffffff, cobalt #0f4cff (light #5b86ff, tint #e5ecff), black #07080c, ink #0b0d14, UI grey #f1f4fa, muted #6b7385. Alternate white, cobalt and black scenes about every 1.4s.
- Render the subject and any icons with real ordered dithering, not a texture: shade each form per pixel on a low-res canvas (~110–190px wide; light from the top left, rim darkening, one specular), threshold against an 8×8 Bayer matrix to pure black and white, and show it at 3x with image-rendering: pixelated. Keep the same treatment in every scene.
- Headlines: DM Serif Display 104–170px, tracking -0.01em, at most three lines, slamming up 80–110px (expo.out 0.5s, 0.12s stagger). ONE word per headline swaps to Covered By Your Grace in cobalt (#5b86ff on black, white on cobalt) at 1.35–2.1x size, revealed left to right with clip-path in 0.4s and underlined by a hand-drawn squiggle that draws on.
- UI pieces are white cards with 34–36px radius and soft shadows, icon wells #eef2fc, Inter 400–600 text at 17–38px, and serif numbers in cobalt; values count up while sliders or bars travel.
- Optional motif: a cobalt stamp slab (~1380×420, -5° rotation, skewX -9°, double white inner border, one 330px white serif word) that drops from scale 3.4 → 1 in 0.16s power3.in, bounces to 1.04 and shakes everything beneath it 8–16px in four quick steps.
- Cuts: a clip-path iris opening from the subject into the next colour (0.55s power2.in), a canvas halftone wipe (a 30×17 dot grid grows to cover the frame, then shrinks away, 0.62s), or a hard cut to black. Fill cobalt and black backgrounds with a dithered dot gradient from a corner or behind the subject, never a smooth glow.
- Pacing: something new lands every ~0.5s and nothing sits still longer than 1s; idle elements float with sine.inOut, pops use back.out(1.6).
- Avoid glossy 3D renders, glow on UI, smooth gradients, more than one script word per headline, and centred title cards that only fade in.
example: The preview follows a dithered 3D mascot through a booking tool launch: product cards on cobalt, a phone storefront, a desktop checkout stamped 'Handled.', a black statement and a white end card. Don't copy this scene unless asked.
